draftBody:
Dear Dev,

Thank you for reaching out to the Panzi Foundation and for sharing the vision behind Third Eye Eternal Flame. We are moved by your commitment to justice for survivors of sexual violence and by the values of protection and accountability that clearly inspire your work.

After careful consideration, we must let you know that at this time we are not in a position to engage in new partnerships, as our current priorities and resources are fully committed to our existing programs and collaborations in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

We sincerely wish you and your community every success as your organization grows, and we encourage you to stay connected with us through our website and social media channels for future updates.

With gratitude and respect,
The Panzi Foundation Team
